import json,collections
rs=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[89]['slots']['1']='ъ'
a[84]['confidence']['3']='low'
a[84]['note']='Final flag is visible but worn in slot 3.'
open('answers.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n' for x in a))
assert len(a)==len(rs)
for r,o in zip(rs,a):
 assert r['item_id']==o['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(o['slots'])==expected
 assert set(o['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in {'ъ','ь','other','u'} for v in o['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in {'high','low'} for v in o['confidence'].values())
 assert o['pre1918'] in {'yes','no','unclear'}
 assert isinstance(o['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
c=collections.Counter(v for o in a for v in o['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, and slot coverage:',len(a),'items;',sum(c.values()),'slots')
print(dict(c))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(o['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for o in a))
